---
title: "Citeproc and Typst"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
bibliography: refs.bib
citeproc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
      - ['<refs>', '<ref-Cronbach_1951>']
      - ['\#bibliography\([^)]*\)']
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
      # Q1's fixture expects the locator without "p." here; Q2 (like pandoc's
      # citeproc) keeps it, as the no-citeproc fixture also asserts.
      # Pandoc collapses the same-author cluster to "(Cronbach 1951a, 1951b)";
      # Q2's citeproc repeats the author ("; Cronbach 1951b"), so accept both
      # (see bd-citeproc-cluster-collapse-kns8uggw).
      - ['\(Cronbach 1951a[,;] (Cronbach )?1951b\)', '\(Cronbach 1951a, p\. 42\)']
      - []
      noErrors: default
---

Hello [@Cronbach_1951; @Cronbach_1952]

With locator: [@Cronbach_1951, p. 42]
